newsitem.title: TAJIKISTAN: Maverick band kidnaps sons of Tajik Muslim leader.
newsitem.headline: Maverick band kidnaps sons of Tajik Muslim leader.

text.p: Two sons of Tajikistan's Moslem leader have been kidnapped by an armed band in another sign of chronic instability in the ex-Soviet state which has lived through a bitter civil war.

"Around 20 masked armed men broke into the house of mufti Amunullo Negmatzoda, disarmed his guards and kidnapped his two sons, aged 15 and 25. Negmatzoda was away at this time," a a local police official told Reuters by telephone late on Friday.

He said the incident had taken place in the village of Daryabad, some five km (3 miles) south-east of the Tajik capital Dushanbe, adding that one of Tajikistan's rogue armed bands could be responsible.

Tajikistan's secular government and the united Islamist opposition signed a final peace agreement on June 27 in Moscow which put an end to a four-year war which claimed the lives of tens of thousands and made many others refugees.
But the shaky peace in the impoverished Central Asian state of 5.7 million people is often disturbed by the maverick bands who have carved Tajikistan into spheres of influence.
